description: This file defines a custom Java annotation '@AllValuesAreNonnullByDefault' that applies the @Nonnull constraint by default to fields, method return values, and parameters within a package, class, or method. It includes metadata annotations for documentation, retention policy, and default applicability.

classes.name: AllValuesAreNonnullByDefault
classes.description: Custom annotation to mark all relevant elements (fields, method return values, parameters) as @Nonnull by default within the scope of package/class/method.
